hreflangReasoning: One Portuguese version written in Brazilian Portuguese. Declare it as hreflang="pt" (language only) so it is eligible for every Portuguese-language searcher: Brazil, Portugal, Angola, Mozambique. 'pt-BR' alone would leave Portugal to x-default (English). The page itself uses <html lang="pt-BR"> and og:locale pt_BR because the copy is Brazilian. Every competitor checked (SavePin, KlickPin, Pinpea, PinterestDownloader, PinterestVideo, ScreenApp) uses 'pt'. Add a separate 'pt-PT' set only if Portugal traffic justifies a true pt-PT rewrite; then switch this set to 'pt-BR' and keep 'pt' pointing at the Brazilian set. URL prefix: /pt (no trailing slash, per normalizeCanonical). Every pt page needs reciprocal alternates (en, pt, x-default→en) plus a self-canonical. Today BaseLayout hard-codes only en + x-default.

markets.notes: Almost all Portuguese demand. Vocabulary: baixar, celular, galeria, PC/notebook, pasta, 'pelo link', 'sem marca d’água', 'grátis'.

Low volume, and searchers mix English ('pinterest download', 'download video pinterest'), pt-PT verbs ('descarregar', 'transferir', 'guardar') and the Brazilian 'baixar' (which autocompletes in PT too). Served by the BR set; add pt-PT terms only where the on-screen label differs (Partilhar, Copiar ligação, Transferir imagem, álbum, telemóvel).

pages.notes: Highest cannibalisation risk: it overlaps the gallery guide. Make it device-procedural (Safari/Files on iOS, Chrome/Downloads on Android, with screenshots in Portuguese UI) and cross-link both pages. If only one guide can be well written, merge this into the gallery page and 301.

glossary._principle: Write Brazilian Portuguese (você, celular, baixar). Use Pinterest's own pt-BR labels in quotes inside steps. Put Portugal variants once, in parentheses, only in steps where the on-screen label differs.

download (verb, CTA).note: BR search verb. 'Fazer download' is fine in prose; avoid 'descarregar'/'transferir' (pt-PT) in BR copy.

downloader (noun).note: Real BR term ('baixador de vídeo pinterest'). Use sparingly in H2/body; prefer the verb in titles.

save to device.note: Distinguish from Pinterest's 'Salvar' (save to a board). When ambiguous, say 'salvar no celular'.

pin.pt: pin (lowercase in prose, plural pins); 'Pin' when quoting Pinterest UI

image pin.pt: pin de imagem / pin de foto

board.note: Pinterest pt-BR term. Portugal: 'álbum' (current UI) / 'painel' (older, still searched). Never 'quadro'/'tabuleiro'/'board' in UI copy.

profile picture / PFP / DP.note: Pinterest UI says 'foto do perfil'. Drop 'DP'. 'pfp' only as a body aside.

Idea Pin / Story.pt: Pin de ideia (antigo); hoje é um pin comum

audio.note: Use both; 'som' is the colloquial noun from TikTok/Reels.

watermark.note: Claim only 'sem marca d’água do PintDownload' / 'não adicionamos marca d’água'.

free.note: Searched with and without accent; write 'grátis'. 'Gratuito' in body.

not affiliated with Pinterest.pt: O PintDownload não é afiliado ao Pinterest, Inc.

bookmarklet.note: Chrome pt-BR: Favoritos, barra de favoritos.

claimTicketMetaphor._rule: Keep the metaphor in gothic labels and stamps. Action buttons always say 'Baixar …' because the user came for that verb and the stub must read as the download action.

claim ticket.note: 'Ticket' is also understood in BR. Avoid 'senha' (it reads as password).

stub (tear-off).note: Exact BR/PT word for the tear-off part of a ticket or receipt. Use it in code and alt text, not as a button label.

Admit one · public link.note: 'Vale 1' is how BR vouchers read. A literal 'ADMITE UM' sounds machine-translated.

No. (serial).note: Uses º (U+00BA), which the latin font subset covers.

Ready · Board / Profile / Carousel / Pro.pt: PRONTO · PASTA / PERFIL / CARROSSEL / FOTO DE PERFIL

receipt.note: BR everyday word for what you get after paying or claiming. 'Recibo' also works.

collect (button).pt: Baixar vídeo / Baixar imagem / Baixar GIF / Baixar ZIP
collect (button).note: Metaphor verb would be 'retirar' (retire no balcão). Use it at most in a label, never as the CTA.

formats.numbers: Decimal comma, period for thousands: 1.234,5. Resolutions and specs stay unformatted: 1080p, 1200 px, 4K. Sizes: 12,4 MB (space before unit).
formats.dates: dd/mm/aaaa (14/10/2026). Long: 14 de outubro de 2026 (lowercase month, no ordinal). Use Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR').
formats.quotes: Curly double quotes “ ” in prose. Apostrophe ’ (marca d’água).
formats.currency: Not needed (free). If ever shown: R$ 0,00. JSON-LD offers may keep price '0'.
formats.capitalisation: Sentence case for H1/H2 source strings (CSS uppercases the gothic). Titles in <title> use title-case-ish caps on content words as written here, the BR SERP norm. Lowercase months and weekdays.

typography.glyphCoverage: public/fonts/big-shoulders-display-latin-{800,900}-normal.woff2 is byte-identical to the @fontsource 'latin' subset (U+0000-00FF, U+2000-206F…). Every Portuguese letter (á â ã à ç é ê í ó ô õ ú, the capitals, º, ’, “ ”, –, —, …, ·) is covered. No latin-ext file is needed.
typography.accentClearance: Measured in the 900 weight (UPM 2000): cap height 1600 (0.80 em), accented capitals Í/É/Ú/À reach y=1958 (0.979 em), Ã/Õ 1922, Ç descends to -314 (-0.157 em). At the specified display line-height of 0.88-0.90, an accent on line 2 rises about 0.08 em above the baseline of line 1. At the 3.75rem desktop H1 that is about 5 px of possible overlap with the letter above. On the first line the accent also sits about 0.14 em outside the line box, so it clips under any overflow:hidden or tight top padding.
typography.recommendation: Under :lang(pt), raise display/headline/article-title line-height to 1.0 (accents clear at 0.979 em), or add padding-top: 0.15em to H1 containers. Check the uppercase H1s 'BAIXAR VÍDEO DO PINTEREST', 'SALVAR VÍDEO DO PINTEREST NA GALERIA' and 'VÍDEO DO PINTEREST NO IPHONE E ANDROID' at 360 px, 1024 px and 1440 px. Never hyphenate headings. hyphens:auto with lang=pt-BR is OK for body text.
typography.lengthExpansion: Headline lengths are close to English (e.g. 'BAIXAR VÍDEO DO PINTEREST' 25 chars vs 'PINTEREST VIDEO DOWNLOADER' 26). The longest pt H1 is 'SALVAR VÍDEO DO PINTEREST NA GALERIA' at 36 chars, and the condensed face absorbs that. Body and UI strings run roughly 15-30% longer: 'Compactando 3 de 40 arquivos…', 'Enviar para o celular' and 'Cortar / redimensionar' can wrap the two-up receipt buttons below 28rem. The stub 'BAIXAR MP4' is shorter than 'DOWNLOAD MP4'.
typography.uppercase: CSS text-transform: uppercase handles Portuguese correctly (ã→Ã, ç→Ç). Keep source strings in sentence case so screen readers and the <title> stay natural.

notes: Rank strategy: Brazilian tool competitors keep English slugs and English or machine-translated H1s (KlickPin 'Pinterest Video Downloader- KlickPin', 'Is KlickPin É seguro usar?'). Native slugs, H1s and FAQs written from real autocomplete questions are the main edge.

Clearest content gaps in Portuguese: board→ZIP ('como baixar várias imagens de uma vez do pinterest'), the GIF that stops moving ('gif do pinterest não mexe'), profile picture download, and an honest Full HD vs 4K explainer.

Brazil-specific intents to answer honestly: 'para postar na Shopee' (repost for Shopee Vídeo affiliate income; give a rights and credit answer); 'sem marca d’água' (the Pinterest app's own video download adds a watermark; we do not add one); 'privado' (not possible; say so).
Native app flow to mirror in every how-to: pin → Compartilhar → 'Baixar' (when the creator allows) or 'Copiar link' → paste here. Portugal: Partilhar → Copiar ligação.

Honesty blockers found in the source: (1) the 'MP3' receipt line saves MP4 bytes under a .mp3 name, so pt copy must not promise MP3 until real encoding exists; (2) the English 4K page overclaims, which is why the pt version is re-angled to Full HD with an honest 4K answer; (3) the English SEO-generator page has an unsourced '+40%' stat, a skip reason. Do not translate any of these claims.
Image quality wording: the extractor upgrades to the 1200px public size (originals return 403). Say 'maior resolução disponível', never 'original/sem compressão'.

Cannibalisation map: home=baixar do pinterest; pin=pelo link; video=baixar vídeo; mp4=formato; full-hd=qualidade; howto=como baixar (all devices, app + link); galeria=destination; iphone-android=device flow; pc=desktop. Cross-link all of them with exact-match anchors in pt.

Skipped: pinterest-story-downloader (format retired; 'pinterest story' means Instagram templates in BR) and pinterest-seo-title-generator (tool outputs English; weak and noisy pt demand). Neither should get a pt URL or a hreflang pair. The English pages keep only en + x-default.
Sitemap: add the pt URLs with xhtml:link alternates. Exclude skipped pages. Keep the IndexNow ping per locale URL.

Every pt page must still pass seo_health_check.py: one H1, canonical, JSON-LD (inLanguage 'pt-BR' in WebPage/HowTo/FAQPage), title 40-62 and description 120-158 chars (validated for every non-skipped page in this file), and non-empty alt text in Portuguese.
